'''2004 World Championship Day 3 Nick Jones LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nick Jones]] at [[2004 World Championship]] (Day 3); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Nick "The Quick" Jones (2004-08-27).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=33568 Day 3 HBX Second Turn Flip]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050518071626/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=33568&PHPSESSID=...328fedb22570524062aeb1303 Internet Archive]</ref>
